goal: Implement Slice S4 of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes): max_parallel above 1 runs several Lanes at once, the report returns handoffs[], a parked Lane no longer blocks scope-disjoint siblings, and QA failures count per child.

acceptance.assertion: Per Interfaces (Report), State transitions and Temporal sequence steps 1-5 of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (sources: user decisions D5, D6; ADR 0013 consequence on per-child QA failure counting): with max_parallel above 1 the reconcile tick keeps up to that many Lanes in flight, emits one provision or executor handoff per child in handoffs[], and integrates settled children serially in settle order. Positive: two scope-disjoint ready children are in flight together and both integrate, each as one commit on the batch branch. Negative: a child whose scope overlaps an in-flight Lane waits until that Lane is integrated; a parked Lane does not stop a disjoint sibling from starting, settling or integrating; a lost or unreadable Lane becomes needs_human with batch_lane_lost and nothing is inferred from terminal text. Bound: the in-flight count never exceeds max_parallel; qa_failure_limit applies to each child separately; batch_parallel_unsupported no longer occurs; a batch without max_parallel is still the serial v1 run. Agreed seam: tests/unattended-batch-lanes.test.ts.

Per Interfaces of docs/specs/parallel-batch-lanes.spec.md (Initiative parallel-batch-lanes) (source: user decision D6; repository evidence that each Lane has its own Host session and store): Claude Code and Pi return equal handoffs[] for the same lane-mode fixture, and Review reservations made in two concurrent Lanes never bind to each other's run. Negative: a Review verdict submitted for one Lane's reservation is refused in the other Lane. Bound: the serial handoff field stays absent in lane mode and handoffs stays absent in serial mode. Closes assumption A5. Agreed seams: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts, tests/claude-batch-authority.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts.
